dimensions.evidence: Observed ORRHeap114, ORCounts66, trial token80, concurrent owner160 and handle2 bytes on Linux x86-64.
Sixteen identities with32strong fields,16root counters,8decrement obligations and16candidate bits. Queued decrements retain removed references until flush.
Generation1..3 then slot retirement; external roots max255; revision1..65535 then mutation refusal and quiescent owner close. Tokens borrow owner lifetime and are not portable serialized authority.
Count equation includes pending charges. Replacement increments before publishing/decrementing; queue space is admitted before any of those changes. Duplicate edges are independent references.
Fixed typed owner; no native allocation for object admission or buffering. Full queue/root/identity/revision failures are unchanged; candidate bits coalesce without allocating.
No payload movement; trial copies66-byte counts into80-byte token. Strong closure and zero selection rescan bounded arrays; generalized time O(V squared+E), not a claimed linear implementation.
Immediate cascade retires at most16objects/32edges per initial decrement; flush budget limits queue entries, each of which may cascade. No recursive destructor or external resource cleanup.
Actual O2 code calls decrement and original or_trial_delete in both compilers. Concurrent adapter calls real pthread mutex functions; no callback or virtual dispatch in the core.

Mutex gives coherent analysis; nonwrapping revision rejects intervening retain/release/store/flush. Actual late worker and1000-versus1000 workload plus TSan are evidence of those bounded runs, not fairness or all-interleaving proof.
Atomic admission and unchanged refusal outputs tested for full queue, root limit, stale/foreign trial and pending analysis. Revision exhaustion has explicit quiescent teardown rather than count wrap.
GCC/Clang O0/O2/O3 exact commands and clean/no-change/header rebuild records. O2 seconds GCC0.70120/0.04443/0.72292; Clang0.55004/0.04327/0.44775. Observed host build work only.

O2 text/data/bss GCC15024/616/16, Clang18256/600/16. release/flush/prepare/commit frames GCC24/48/128/8, Clang24/56/88/0; trial kernel128/104. GCC prepare has stack-check helper. No freestanding or whole-call-chain bound.
Original serialized C17 core and hosted POSIX wrapper. No concurrent raw traversal or atomic-load-before-retain safety follows; clients still supply owner lifetime, quiescence and unmodified tokens.

observation: 540retained+36warmups;1000 eight-object cycles/sample. O2 cycle immediate/deferred1/deferred8 medians ns: GCC295003/324066/292237; Clang195693/221868/216454. Terminal identity/count contracts equal within each graph shape; no universal ordering inferred.

sealed_decision.choice: Keep ordinary zero release separate; use bounded deferred charges and explicit mutex/revision trial publication when the caller needs deferred work.
sealed_decision.reason: Deferred queue reduces immediate count work but adds retention and admission/flush obligations; a mutex snapshot gives a simple stated correctness model.
sealed_decision.reopen_when: Unbounded heaps, hard latency deadlines, raw concurrent traversal or lock-free progress become requirements.
